system.description: When your mind is set, your will does not break easily. If Dominate affects you, you may spend a Willpower Trait to retest; win, and the effect is negated and you gain five minutes' immunity to further Dominate. Against mind-altering magic or Thaumaturgy resolved with a Mental Challenge, you gain three Bonus Traits in defense. This Merit does not protect against Presence or other social manipulation.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
